title: Database studio
subtitle: The design of {source}, read from its Prisma files

stats.coverageTip: {named} of {total} tables and columns have an Arabic name

actions.refreshTip: Read the Prisma files again. A new version is kept only when they changed.
actions.suggestNamesTip: Claude fills in the names and descriptions that are missing. You can edit every one after.
actions.relayoutTip: Forget the places you dragged tables to
actions.syncNamesTip: A draft with no changes, so Claude writes the Arabic names as /// comments.

inspector.label: Details
inspector.nameArHint: A short name a business reader understands
inspector.descriptionArHint: What it holds and why it exists
inspector.notesHint: Anything worth knowing: rules, history, plans
inspector.unsyncedTip: It is written into the files as a /// comment when a draft is applied.
inspector.impliedRelation: Implied by the column's name, no foreign key
inspector.readOnly: Your roles can read this design but not name or change it.

history.title: Versions of the design
history.empty: One version so far. Each refresh that finds a change adds one.

draft.label: Draft
draft.empty: No changes yet. Propose one from a table or a column.
draft.reviewTip: Opens a chat in the Claude panel, in Plan, in the schema's folder: Claude reviews and discusses first; it changes files only when you switch to Execute.
draft.discardBody: Its changes are dropped. The design itself does not change.

statusHints.editing: Add, edit and order the changes, then send them to review.
statusHints.in_review: Discuss it in the panel. When you agree, switch the chat to Execute.
statusHints.applying: Claude is editing the Prisma files and the migration. The page updates when it finishes.
statusHints.applied: Applied. The diagram shows the new design.

draft.noPanel: The Claude panel is not available here. Open the project from the sidebar and try again.
draft.noFolder: The schema's folder {folder} is not linked on this device. Add it to the project's folders, or pick it in the panel.
draft.sent: Sent to Claude in Plan. The review runs in the panel.
draft.refused: The panel could not start the chat. Check the device in the panel.

change.title: Propose a change
change.targetHint: A table (Booking), a column (Booking.status), or the new name
change.summaryHint: One line: make status required, add a refunds table…
change.detailHint: Types, attributes or Prisma lines, as precise as you like
change.reasonHint: The business reason. It helps Claude review it.

search.title: Search the design
search.placeholder: A table, a column, an Arabic name…
search.hint: Enter opens it in the diagram

setup.title: Where is the database design?
setup.body: Hub reads the Prisma files of one of the project's folders. Nothing in the folder is changed by reading it.
setup.name: Name
setup.pathHint: One of the project's folders, such as F:\Goteav\backend
setup.schemaDirHint: A folder of .prisma files, or one .prisma file
setup.deviceHint: Pick a device when the folder is not on the machine running Hub.
setup.readOnly: No schema source is set yet. Ask the owner or the backend to set one.

states.error: The design could not be loaded
states.notRead: The design has not been read yet.
states.warningsTip: These lines are skipped in the diagram. Prisma still reads them.

toasts.unchanged: No change since the last read
toasts.namesSent: Sent to Claude. The names appear here as it saves them.
